EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a clear aldehyde signature: a strong C=O near 1727 cm⁻¹ and the characteristic aldehydic C–H Fermi resonance doublet at ~2719 and ~2795 cm⁻¹. The intense band at 767 cm⁻¹ is consistent with the aldehyde CH wagging mode. The CH-stretch cluster (2879–2972 cm⁻¹) and CH₃/CH₂ deformation at 1454 cm⁻¹ fit an aliphatic keto‑aldehyde. Candidates 4 and 10 (α-dicarbonyls) would more likely produce split/shifted carbonyl bands or extra CH₃ features (e.g., stronger ~1375 cm⁻¹) not observed. Candidate 9 (CCC(=O)CC=O) best matches the aldehyde plus ketone pattern without extra functionalities.
